coll.sql: SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(' ',O.COD_REC_OT_CABECERA) AS MAP_NUMEROORDEN, CONCAT(' ',O.OBSERVACIONES) AS MAP_OBSERVACIONES, IFNULL(IFNULL(ct.G3E_FID,ctc.G3E_FID),0) AS MAP_G3E_FID, IFNULL(IFNULL(ct.G3E_FNO,ctc.G3E_FNO),0) AS MAP_G3E_FNO, CASE WHEN substr(O.BRIGADA,4,1) = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MAP_EXTERNO, CONCAT('Revisión Inventario - OBLIGATORIA') as MAP_TITLE_REVINV, (select count(*) from gen_cambiosinventario cin WHERE cin.COD_REC_OT_CABECERA=O.COD_REC_OT_CABECERA AND cin.G3E_FID=IFNULL(ct.G3E_FID,ctc.G3E_FID) AND cin.G3E_FNO=IFNULL(ct.G3E_FNO,ctc.G3E_FNO)) AS MAP_CAMBIO_INV, CID.VALOR,IFNULL(ct.ID_CHIP_NFC,ctc.ID_CHIP_NFC), CASE WHEN CID.VALOR IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN IFNULL(ct.ID_CHIP_NFC,ctc.ID_CHIP_NFC) IS NULL THEN '/var/www/vhosts/xoneideintcore.com/core/xonemonitorcore/Monitor/Apoyo_Etiquetado_Blanco.png' WHEN IFNULL(ct.ID_CHIP_NFC,ctc.ID_CHIP_NFC) = '11:11:11:11:11' THEN '/var/www/vhosts/xoneideintcore.com/core/xonemonitorcore/Monitor/Apoyo_Etiquetado_Azul.png' ELSE '/var/www/vhosts/xoneideintcore.com/core/xonemonitorcore/Monitor/Apoyo_Etiquetado_Verde.png' END WHEN CID.VALOR = '11:11:11:11:11' THEN '/var/www/vhosts/xoneideintcore.com/core/xonemonitorcore/Monitor/Apoyo_Etiquetado_Azul.png' ELSE '/var/www/vhosts/xoneideintcore.com/core/xonemonitorcore/Monitor/Apoyo_Etiquetado_Verde.png' END AS MAP_ICONO_ETIQUETADO, CASE WHEN CID.VALOR IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN IFNULL(ct.ID_CHIP_NFC,ctc.ID_CHIP_NFC) IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN IFNULL(ct.ID_CHIP_NFC,ctc.ID_CHIP_NFC) = '11:11:11:11:11' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHEN CID.VALOR = '11:11:11:11:11' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MAP_VER_NO_ACCESIBLE, IFNULL(ct.ID_CHIP_NFC,ctc.ID_CHIP_NFC), CONCAT(' CT ',ct.SAP_TPLNR,' - ', CASE WHEN CID.VALOR IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN IFNULL(ct.ID_CHIP_NFC,ctc.ID_CHIP_NFC) IS NULL THEN ' CT Sin etiquetar' WHEN IFNULL(ct.ID_CHIP_NFC,ctc.ID_CHIP_NFC) = '11:11:11:11:11' THEN ' CT no Accesible' ELSE ' CT Accesible' END WHEN CID.VALOR = '11:11:11:11:11' THEN ' CT No Accesible' ELSE ' CT Etiquetado' END) AS MAP_DESCRIPCION_CT, '/var/www/vhosts/xoneideintcore.com/core/xonemonitorcore/Monitor/qr_iberdrola.png' AS MAP_QR, concat('RESUMEN REC - ',O.COD_REC_OT_CABECERA ) AS MAP_TITULO, '/var/www/vhosts/xoneideintcore.com/core/xonemonitorcore/Monitor/ide_iberdrola.png' AS MAP_LOGO, O.ID as ID, O.COD_REC_OT_CABECERA, concat(' ',CASE WHEN O.UBICACION_TECNICA IS NOT NULL THEN concat(O.UBICACION_TECNICA,' - ') ELSE '' END,O.NOMBRE_UBICACION) AS MAP_INSTALACION, 'Revisión de inventario' as MAP_TITLE_ELMCTI, (SELECT count(*) FROM gen_ri_ot_elementos_rev er WHERE er.COD_REC_OT_CABECERA = O.COD_REC_OT_CABECERA ) as MAP_VER_ELMCTI, 'Estudio de Inundabilidad' AS MAP_TITLE_INUNDABILIDAD, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM gen_inundabilidad_rec_bloques_rev ir WHERE ir.COD_REC_OT_CABECERA = O.COD_REC_OT_CABECERA AND ir.revisado = 1) AS MAP_VER_INUNDABILIDAD, O.UBICACION_TECNICA AS MAP_UBICACION_TECNICA from gen_rec_ot_cabecera O left outer join gen_ct ct on ct.g3e_fid = O.FID_UT left outer join gen_ctc ctc on ctc.g3e_fid = O.FID_UT left join gen_maestroveclactmvl gm on gm.COD_CLA_CTM = IFNULL(ct.COD_CLA_CT,ctc.COD_CLA_CTC) LEFT OUTER JOIN (select MAX(ID) AS ID,G3E_FID,G3E_FNO,ATTR from gen_cambiosinventario WHERE TIPO='CT_ETQ' AND ATTR='ID_CHIP_NFC' group by G3E_FID,G3E_FNO,ATTR) CI ON CI.G3E_FID=IFNULL(ct.G3E_FID,ctc.G3E_FID) AND CI.G3E_FNO=IFNULL(ct.G3E_FNO,ctc.G3E_FNO) LEFT OUTER JOIN gen_cambiosinventario CID ON CID.ID=CI.ID AND CID.COD_REC_OT_CABECERA=O.COD_REC_OT_CABECERA
coll.filter: O.ID=##ID## and (ct.ID is not null or ctc.ID is not NULL) order by O.ID DESC

coll.sql: SELECT CONCAT(' ', CASE WHEN ct.B_INUNDABILIDAD = 1 THEN 'SI' WHEN ct.B_INUNDABILIDAD = 0 THEN 'NO' ELSE '' END) AS MAP_B_INUNDABILIDAD, CONCAT(' ', IFNULL(ct.CAN_ALT_INUND, '')) AS MAP_CAN_ALT_INUND, CONCAT(' ', CASE WHEN ct.B_INUNDADO = 1 THEN 'SI' WHEN ct.B_INUNDADO = 0 THEN 'NO' ELSE '' END) AS MAP_B_INUNDADO, CONCAT(' ', IFNULL(ct.CAN_ALT_RASANTE_SUELO, '')) AS MAP_CAN_ALT_RASANTE_SUELO, CONCAT(' ', IFNULL(ct.CAN_ALT_RASANTE_AGUA, '')) AS MAP_CAN_ALT_RASANTE_AGUA, CONCAT(' ', IFNULL(mrv.DES_DESCRIPCION, '')) AS MAP_RIESGO_INUND, CONCAT(' ', IFNULL(ct.CAN_ALT_RASANTE_EQ_STAR, '')) AS MAP_CAN_ALT_RASANTE_EQ_STAR, CONCAT(' ', IFNULL(ct.CAN_ALT_RASANTE_MAN_CEL, '')) AS MAP_CAN_ALT_RASANTE_MAN_CEL, CONCAT(' ', IFNULL(ct.CAN_ALT_RASANTE_CBT, '')) AS MAP_CAN_ALT_RASANTE_CBT FROM gen_ct ct LEFT JOIN gen_inundabilidad_rec_bloques_rev rev ON rev.G3E_FID = ct.G3E_FID AND rev.G3E_FNO = ct.G3E_FNO LEFT JOIN gen_maestrovetipriesgoinundvl mrv ON mrv.COD_TIP_RIESGO_INUND = ct.COD_TIP_RIESGO_INUND

VALOR*/ left join gen_maestroveclactmvl gm on gm.COD_CLA_CTM = gropa.VALOR and gropa.ATTR='COD_CLA_CT' LEFT JOIN gen_maestrovetipctmvl gm2 on gm2.COD_TIP_CTM = gropa.VALOR and gropa.ATTR='COD_TIP_CT' gm17.COD_TIP_INTERC = gropa.VALOR and gropa.ATTR IN ('COD_TIP_INTERC_MT','COD_TIP_INTERC_BT') left JOIN gen_maestrovetensdisevl gm18 on gm18.COD_TENS_NOMI = gropa.VALOR and gropa.ATTR IN ('COD_TENS_NOMI_PRI','COD_TENS_NOMI_SEC') left JOIN gen_maestrovetipbornavl gm19 on gm19.COD_TIP_BORNA = gropa.VALOR and gropa.ATTR='COD_TIP_BORNA' left JOIN gen_maestrovetipgrconextrafovl gm20 on gm20.COD_TIP_GRUPO_CONEX_TRAFO = gropa.VALOR and gropa.ATTR='COD_TIP_GRUPO_CONEX_TRAFO' left JOIN gen_maestrovetensservvl gm21 on gm21.COD_TENS_SERV = gropa.VALOR and gropa.ATTR='COD_TENS_SERV' left JOIN gen_maestrovefuncuadrobtvl gm22 on gm22.COD_FUN_CUADRO_BT = gropa.VALOR and gropa.ATTR='COD_FUN_CUADRO_BT' left JOIN gen_maestrovemodcuadrobtvl gm23 on gm23.COD_MOD_CUADRO_BT = gropa.VALOR and gropa.ATTR='COD_MOD_CUADRO_BT' left JOIN gen_maestrovetipmatinterconexvl gm24 on gm24.COD_TIP_MAT_INTERC = gropa.VALOR and gropa.ATTR='COD_TIP_MAT_INTERC_BT' /*PARA VALOR ANT*/ left join gen_maestroveclactmvl gm0 on gm0.COD_CLA_CTM = gropa.VALOR_ANT and gropa.ATTR='COD_CLA_CT' LEFT JOIN gen_maestrovetipctmvl gm02 on gm02.COD_TIP_CTM = gropa.VALOR_ANT and gropa.ATTR='COD_TIP_CT' left JOIN gen_maestrovbestadovl gm03 on gm03.STATE = gropa.VALOR_ANT and gropa.ATTR='STATE' left JOIN gen_maestrovetiptelemctctcvl gm04 on gm04.COD_TIP_TELEMANDO_CT_CTC = gropa.VALOR_ANT and gropa.ATTR='COD_TIP_TELEMANDO_CT_CTC' left JOIN gen_maestrovetiptelegestionvl gm05 on gm05.COD_TIP_TELEGEST_BT = gropa.VALOR_ANT and gropa.ATTR='COD_TIP_TELEGEST_BT' left JOIN gen_maestrovlmunicipiovl gm06 on gm06.COD_MUNICIPIO = gropa.VALOR_ANT and gropa.ATTR='COD_MUNICIPIO' left JOIN gen_maestrovetipceldavl gm07 on gm07.COD_TIP_CELDA = gropa.VALOR_ANT and gropa.ATTR='COD_TIP_CELDA' left JOIN (select MAX(ID) AS ID,COD_FUN_CELDA,DES_DESCRIPCION FROM gen_maestrovefunceldavl group by COD_FUN_CELDA,DES_DESCRIPCION) gm08 on gm08.COD_FUN_CELDA = gropa.VALOR_ANT and gropa.ATTR='COD_FUN_CELDA' left JOIN gen_maestrovlentsingulvl gm09 on gm09.COD_ENT_SING_POBLAC = gropa.VALOR_ANT and gropa.ATTR='COD_TENS_NOMI' left JOIN gen_maestrovbfabricantvl gm010 on gm010.COD_FAB = gropa.VALOR_ANT and gropa.ATTR IN ('COD_FAB_CELDA','COD_FAB_ELEM_MANI','COD_FAB') left JOIN gen_maestrovemodceldavl gm011 on gm011.COD_MOD_CELDA = gropa.VALOR_ANT and gropa.ATTR='COD_MOD_CELDA' left JOIN gen_maestrovetippatceldavl gm012 on gm012.COD_TIP_PAT_CELDA = gropa.VALOR_ANT and gropa.ATTR='COD_TIP_PAT_CELDA' left JOIN gen_maestrovefununifnclvl gm013 on gm013.COD_FUN_UNID_FUNC = gropa.VALOR_ANT and gropa.ATTR='COD_FUN_UNID_FUNC' left JOIN gen_maestrovetipelemmanivl gm014 on gm014.COD_TIP_ELEM_MANI = gropa.VALOR_ANT and gropa.ATTR='COD_TIP_ELEM_MANI' left JOIN gen_maestroveclaelemmanivl gm015 on gm015.COD_CLA_ELEM_MANI = gropa.VALOR_ANT and gropa.ATTR='COD_CLA_ELEM_MANI' left JOIN gen_maestrovemodelemmanivl gm016 on gm016.COD_MOD_ELEM_MANI = gropa.VALOR_ANT and gropa.ATTR='COD_MOD_ELEM_MANI' left JOIN gen_maestrovetipinterconexvl gm017 on gm017.COD_TIP_INTERC = gropa.VALOR_ANT and gropa.ATTR IN ('COD_TIP_INTERC_MT','COD_TIP_INTERC_BT') left JOIN gen_maestrovetensdisevl gm018 on gm018.COD_TENS_NOMI = gropa.VALOR_ANT and gropa.ATTR IN ('COD_TENS_NOMI_PRI','COD_TENS_NOMI_SEC') left JOIN gen_maestrovetipbornavl gm019 on gm019.COD_TIP_BORNA = gropa.VALOR_ANT and gropa.ATTR='COD_TIP_BORNA' left JOIN gen_maestrovetipgrconextrafovl gm020 on gm020.COD_TIP_GRUPO_CONEX_TRAFO = gropa.VALOR_ANT and gropa.ATTR='COD_TIP_GRUPO_CONEX_TRAFO' left JOIN gen_maestrovetensservvl gm021 on gm021.COD_TENS_SERV = gropa.VALOR_ANT and gropa.ATTR='COD_TENS_SERV' left JOIN gen_maestrovefuncuadrobtvl gm022 on gm022.COD_FUN_CUADRO_BT = gropa.VALOR_ANT and gropa.ATTR='COD_FUN_CUADRO_BT' left JOIN gen_maestrovemodcuadrobtvl gm023 on gm023.COD_MOD_CUADRO_BT = gropa.VALOR_ANT and gropa.ATTR='COD_MOD_CUADRO_BT' left JOIN gen_maestrovetipmatinterconexvl gm024 on gm024.COD_TIP_MAT_INTERC = gropa.VALOR_ANT and gropa.ATTR='COD_TIP_MAT_INTERC_BT' ) SELECT
mp.PROPIEDAD, gropa.ID,
CONCAT(' ',mp.TIPO_PROPIEDAD) AS MAP_PROPIEDAD, CONCAT(' ',mp.TIPO_PROPIEDAD) AS MAP_PROPIEDAD2, CONCAT(' ',mp.TIPO_PROPIEDAD) AS MAP_PROPIEDAD3,
CONCAT(' ',CASE WHEN mp.REQUIERE_DIBUJO = 1 THEN 'Si' ELSE 'No' END) AS MAP_REQUIERE_DIBUJO, CONCAT(' ',CASE WHEN mp.REQUIERE_DIBUJO = 1 THEN 'Si' ELSE 'No' END) AS MAP_REQUIERE_DIBUJO2, CONCAT(' ',CASE WHEN mp.REQUIERE_DIBUJO = 1 THEN 'Si' ELSE 'No' END) AS MAP_REQUIERE_DIBUJO3,
CONCAT(' ',pv.MAP_VALOR_ANT) AS MAP_VALOR_PROPIEDAD, CONCAT(' ',pv.MAP_VALOR_ANT) AS MAP_VALOR_PROPIEDAD2, CONCAT(' ',pv.MAP_VALOR_ANT) AS MAP_VALOR_PROPIEDAD3,
CONCAT(' ',mp.DESCRIPCION) AS MAP_DESCRIPCION, CONCAT(' ',mp.DESCRIPCION) AS MAP_DESCRIPCION2, CONCAT(' ',mp.DESCRIPCION) AS MAP_DESCRIPCION3,
@accion := CONCAT(' ',CASE WHEN (mp.TIPO_PROPIEDAD = 'MANUAL' or mp.TIPO_PROPIEDAD = 'CAMPO') and gropa.ID IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('"Nuevo valor" ',ifnull(pv.MAP_VALOR,'Vacio')) WHEN mp.TIPO_PROPIEDAD = 'AUTOMATICA' THEN CASE WHEN gropa.ID IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('Corrección automática ',ifnull(pv.MAP_VALOR,'')) END WHEN mp.TIPO_PROPIEDAD = 'EXPERTO' THEN CASE WHEN gropa.ID IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'Solictud de corrección' END ELSE '' END), @accion as MAP_ACCION, @accion as MAP_ACCION2, @accion as MAP_ACCION3,
CASE WHEN gropa.ID IS NOT NULL AND gropa.MODIFICACION=1 THEN CASE WHEN gropa.VALOR IS NULL OR LENGTH(gropa.VALOR) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 2 END ELSE 1 END AS MAP_COLOR_VISIBLE,
@corregir := CONCAT(' ',CASE WHEN gropa.ID IS NOT NULL AND gropa.MODIFICACION=1 THEN CASE WHEN gropa.VALOR IS NULL OR LENGTH(gropa.VALOR) = 0 THEN 'Si' ELSE 'No' END ELSE 'No' END),
@corregir as MAP_CORREGIR, @corregir as MAP_CORREGIR2, @corregir as MAP_CORREGIR3,
